'''Seefor''', designated '''CT-12/74''', was a [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone Commando]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Ord Cestus Squad|squad]] on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a communications expert.<ref name="Cestus Deception" />

Along with fellow clone commandos [[Forry]] and [[Sirty]], Seefor attempted to stop [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class ARC]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jangotat|Nate]] from violating their code, which Nate was doing by not following the instructions that [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Fisto]] gave them.<ref name="Cestus Deception" />
